help:
Usage: overpass listen --forward-to <url> --key <test key> --api <Overpass API url>

Replays the webhooks simulated by the Overpass sandbox on your local server.
Outgoing connection only: no tunnel, no public URL, no open port.

Options:
  --forward-to  your local server, for example http://localhost:3000/webhook
  --key         Overpass test key (or the OVERPASS_KEY variable)
  --api         Overpass API URL (or the OVERPASS_API_URL variable)
  --help        shows this help
ready: Relay ready for {provider}, key {keyPrefix}. Webhooks are replayed to {forwardTo}. Ctrl+C to stop.
report_failed: The result of this delivery could not be sent to Overpass.
unauthorized: Test key refused. Check that it is active and copied in full from the sandbox page.

errors.missing_forward: Give your local server with --forward-to, for example http://localhost:3000/webhook.
errors.missing_key: Give your test key with --key or the OVERPASS_KEY variable.
errors.missing_api: Give the Overpass API with --api or the OVERPASS_API_URL variable.
errors.invalid_forward: --forward-to must be an http or https URL.
errors.invalid_key: The key must start with ovp_test_.
errors.invalid_api: --api must be an http or https URL.
errors.unknown_command: Unknown command. Use overpass listen or overpass --help.
